test_cases.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation button is disabled when image has no annotations
when the user selects an image with no existing annotations
test_cases.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Default Disabled State

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation button is disabled when image has no annotations

Given the user selects an image with no existing annotations
When the image is loaded
Then the Copy Annotation button should be disabled
test_cases.acceptance:
The Copy Annotation button should be disabled
The behavior should be validated when the image is loaded.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation button is enabled when image has annotations
when the user selects an image with at least one saved annotation
test_cases.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Enabled State for Annotated Image

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation button is enabled when image has annotations

Given the user selects an image with at least one saved annotation
When the image is loaded
Then the Copy Annotation button should be enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
The Copy Annotation button should be enabled
The behavior should be validated when the image is loaded.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation button becomes enabled after saving an annotation
when the user selects an image with no annotations
test_cases.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Enable After Save

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation button becomes enabled after saving an annotation

Given the user selects an image with no annotations
When the user adds and saves a new annotation
Then the Copy Annotation button should become enabled immediately
test_cases.acceptance:
The Copy Annotation button should become enabled immediately
The behavior should be validated when the user adds and saves a new annotation.

test_cases.summary:
Verify button state updates when switching between images
when the user switches between images with and without annotations
test_cases.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Dynamic State Update on Image Change

Scenario: Verify button state updates when switching between images

Given the user switches between images with and without annotations
When a new image is selected
Then the Copy Annotation button state should update dynamically based on annotation presence
test_cases.acceptance:
The Copy Annotation button state should update dynamically based on annotation presence
The behavior should be validated when a new image is selected.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation action cannot be triggered when disabled
when the selected image has no annotations
test_cases.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Disabled Action Protection

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation action cannot be triggered when disabled

Given the selected image has no annotations
When the user attempts to click the disabled Copy Annotation button
Then no action should be triggered
test_cases.acceptance:
No action should be triggered
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to click the disabled Copy Annotation button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify keyboard shortcut is supported for copying annotations
when the user is viewing an image with saved annotations
test_cases.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Shortcut Availability

Scenario: Verify keyboard shortcut is supported for copying annotations

Given the user is viewing an image with saved annotations
When the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Right Arrow
Then the system should initiate the copy annotations action
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should initiate the copy annotations action
The behavior should be validated when the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Right Arrow.

test_cases.summary:
Verify annotations are copied to the next image using shortcut
when the current image has one or more saved annotations
test_cases.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Copy to Next Image via Shortcut

Scenario: Verify annotations are copied to the next image using shortcut

Given the current image has one or more saved annotations
When the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Right Arrow
Then all saved annotations should be copied to the next image
test_cases.acceptance:
All saved annotations should be copied to the next image
The behavior should be validated when the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Right Arrow.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation button triggers manual copy flow
when the Copy Annotation button is enabled
test_cases.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Manual Copy Option

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation button triggers manual copy flow

Given the Copy Annotation button is enabled
When the user clicks the Copy Annotation button
Then the system should open the image selection popup
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should open the image selection popup
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Copy Annotation button.
